Cache hit with OpenDAL memory backend returns cached response on repeat request

```swift title="Swift"
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"Hello\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"openai/gpt-4o\"}")
let _client = try createClientFromJson(json: "{\"api_key\":\"your-api-key\",\"cache\":{\"backend\":\"opendal:memory\",\"max_entries\":256,\"ttl_seconds\":300}}")
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
print(result)
```
